author: Linnaeus, 1758

note.en: A diving duck of northern coasts; a few research-grade iNaturalist records exist from December 2019 near Limón and Westfalia and from Bocas del Toro in 2021, so treat it as a rare vagrant (CHECK with a local bird committee).
note.es: Un pato buceador de costas del norte; hay unos pocos registros de iNaturalist de diciembre de 2019 cerca de Limón y Westfalia y de Bocas del Toro en 2021, por lo que debe tratarse como un vagabundo raro (VERIFICAR con un comité local de aves).

evidence: iNaturalist: 6 research-grade records in the box (2 near Limón and Westfalia, Dec 2019; others Bocas del Toro, 2021)

sources.t: iNaturalist taxon page and regional observations
Garrigues & Dean, The Birds of Costa Rica: A Field Guide (2nd ed., 2014), status and range

recWhy: Records near Limón and Westfalia[^3] and Bocas del Toro.

marks.en: Slim diving duck with a thin red serrated bill and a shaggy crest; male has a dark green head, white collar and rusty breast.
marks.es: Pato buceador esbelto con pico rojo fino y aserrado y cresta despeinada; el macho tiene cabeza verde oscura, collar blanco y pecho rojizo.
